items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: i was with tony america 17 years i stayed with him spotting

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: well i don't think you're gonna ask him much more because the tape's gonna run out it's about to run out well like i say he played mostly with everybody he played with shockey here and he played with johnny detroit for a while and and as far as spotting you played with probably everybody that's mostly been in the union you know spotted at some time

i spotted around with my most famous band in the city of new orleans so he went with tony for the last 17 years i was with tony america 17 years i stayed with him spotting that's a long time yeah 17 years with one band a long time

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: i think he was the longest man in the band see he had nina and he had uh bobby before joe went to break with her mother and he let you out with those boys go but he still stayed on with them after they came off the boat and uh he's the longest man really was he stayed with tony for the time he went with him he had tony used to have uh brunus playing drums with him until he died what was his name daddy who the one died played the drums with tony brunus uh abby was his name abby too
